title: Power of Attorney Record Agent Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=poa:record agent_count=*
| stats sum(agent_count) as total_value, avg(agent_count) as avg_value by poa_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks POA type values by total and average agent count across power of attorney record events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `agent_count` values for each power of attorney record event and review total and average agent count by POA type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total agent count.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which POA type shows the biggest agent count numbers in your power of attorney record data.
